# 20-prompt fixture for CF-2-R (spec §8 statistical floor; gate n>=10).
what should I do first?
how do I prioritize this week?
give me a short plan for shipping
what is the smallest next step?
how would you push back on scope creep?
what would you say to a stressed teammate?
draft a one-line status update
how do I explain a delay honestly?
what is a good way to ask for help?
how should I run a quick retro?
what tone fits a late-night check-in?
how do I celebrate a small win?
what is a concise apology that sounds human?
how do I decline a meeting politely?
what is a good follow-up after no reply?
how do I ask for clearer requirements?
what would you say to unblock a stuck PR?
how do I end a thread without sounding cold?
what is a warm way to say no for now?
